##### Project general facts

4B Living by HSE Realty is a contemporary residential development in Dubai, designed to offer a refined balance of comfort, functionality, and modern living. The architecture reflects a clean and well-planned design approach, where efficient layouts and high-quality construction standards create a practical yet elegant residential environment. Developed with German standards of precision, the project focuses on durability, comfort, and long-term value, ensuring a thoughtfully executed living space for its residents.

The development offers a lifestyle enriched with a range of premium amenities designed for relaxation and everyday convenience. Residents can enjoy a private swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, landscaped outdoor seating areas, and dedicated children’s play zones. Additional services such as 24-hour concierge support enhance comfort and security, while the overall environment is designed to support a calm, well-organised, and family-friendly lifestyle within a modern urban setting.

Inside, 4B Living features fully finished interiors crafted with high-quality materials that reflect both durability and modern style. Kitchens are equipped with German-brand appliances, ensuring reliability and functionality, while apartments include built-in wardrobes and full air-conditioning systems for added convenience. The residences are fully furnished, offering a complete move-in-ready solution that combines practicality with a comfortable and stylish living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai International City offers a gently evolving neighbourhood where the city's constant motion gives way to a gentler pace, creating an environment that feels increasingly rare in a metropolis that never slows down. This thoughtfully planned community is framed by the natural beauty of Dubai Safari Park and the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary, with interconnected parks, shaded pathways, and open spaces that weave nature seamlessly into everyday life. From the still waters of Warsan Lake to wide parks and tree-lined green corridors, the neighbourhood wraps nature beautifully around daily living, softening the city's edges and turning home into a place residents are always drawn back to.

Life within Dubai International City is defined by its community-centric design, with walkable neighbourhoods, unfenced parks, and integrated lifestyle spaces that foster connection and wellbeing. Anchored within the twenty-minute city framework, this is a neighbourhood that will define the city's evolution, offering lively shopping destinations, independent boutiques, neighbourhood cafes, acclaimed restaurants, and entertainment venues that place the full spectrum of city life right at your doorstep. The area's bio-diverse ecozones, including the vital wetland ecosystem of Al Warsan Lake, support diverse migratory and native birdlife, weaving nature into Dubai's evolving urban landscape.

The surroundings of Dubai International City benefit from its alignment with Dubai's 2040 Green Spine vision, ensuring that the community remains at the forefront of sustainable and thoughtful urban planning. The neighbourhood's strategic location provides convenient access to key destinations while maintaining a serene and peaceful atmosphere that feels wonderfully removed from the city's relentless pace. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the tranquility of a nature-infused community with the dynamic allure of one of the world's most exciting cities.
